instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: When I leave a note saying no one was home, I feel a little sad too, but then I go to the next house. I really want fewer re-deliveries. They are hard on us too. Even so, I can't simply say customers should pay the cost. I think the cost should be part of the general fee for carrying packages. That makes more sense than charging each person who is not home for their re-delivery. I want the company to think about whether free delivery for online orders should stay as it is. If it changes delivery fees, I want it to look at how it sets them too. Then the money can really reach the people who deliver packages.
